title: Judgment on Wicked Counselors and Promise of Restoration

questions.question: Where did the Spirit lift Ezekiel and bring him in chapter 11?
options: To the east gate of the house of the Lord
To the valley of dry bones
questions.correctAnswer: To the east gate of the house of the Lord
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:1 (ESV): "The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the Lord, which faces east."

questions.question: How many men did Ezekiel see at the door of the gateway?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:1 (ESV): "And behold, at the door of the gateway there were twenty-five men."

questions.question: Among the twenty-five men, which two princes of the people did Ezekiel specifically name?
options: Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah
Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, and Ishmael
questions.correctAnswer: Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:1 (ESV): "Among them I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people."

questions.question: God told Ezekiel, "Son of man, these are the men who devise... and who give wicked counsel in this city."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:2 (ESV): "And he said to me, 'Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity and who give wicked counsel in this city;'"

questions.question: What analogy did these wicked counselors use to describe themselves and the city?
options: "The city is the cauldron, and we are the meat."
"We are the roots of a mighty cedar."
"The city is a strong tower, and we are the watchmen."
"We are the gold refined in the fire."
questions.correctAnswer: "The city is the cauldron, and we are the meat."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:3 (ESV): "who say, 'The time is not near to build houses. This city is the cauldron, and we are the meat.'"

questions.question: What did the Spirit of the Lord tell Ezekiel to prophesy against them regarding the slain in the city?
options: "Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the meat, and this city is the cauldron, but you shall be brought out of the midst of it."
"The fire will consume both the meat and the cauldron."
"You have become bones without flesh in this cauldron."
"The cauldron will be poured out to the Babylonians."
questions.correctAnswer: "Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the meat, and this city is the cauldron, but you shall be brought out of the midst of it."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:7 (ESV): "Therefore thus says the Lord God: Your slain whom you have laid in the midst of it, they are the meat, and this city is the cauldron, but you shall be brought out of the midst of it."

questions.question: "You have feared the..., and I will bring the... upon you, declares the Lord God."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:8 (ESV): "You have feared the sword, and I will bring the sword upon you, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: Where does God say He will judge these wicked counselors?
options: In the valley of dry bones
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:10 (ESV): "You shall fall by the sword. I will judge you at the border of Israel, and you shall know that I am the Lord."

questions.question: What happened to Pelatiah the son of Benaiah while Ezekiel was prophesying?
options: He threw a stone at Ezekiel
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:13 (ESV): "And it came to pass, while I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died."

questions.question: How did Ezekiel react when Pelatiah died?
options: He fell down on his face and cried out, "Ah, Lord God! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?"
He said, "So perish all the wicked."
He fled from the men out of fear
He continued his prophecy without pausing
questions.correctAnswer: He fell down on his face and cried out, "Ah, Lord God! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:13 (ESV): "Then I fell down on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, 'Ah, Lord God! Will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel?'"

questions.question: What did the inhabitants of Jerusalem say concerning Ezekiel's kinsmen, the men of his redemption, and all the house of Israel in exile?
options: "They have gone far from the Lord; to us this land is given for a possession."
"They are coming back soon to rule over us."
"They deserved the sword of the Chaldeans."
"Let us send them money and provisions."
questions.correctAnswer: "They have gone far from the Lord; to us this land is given for a possession."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:15 (ESV): "they are the ones of whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, 'They have gone far from the Lord; to us this land is given for a possession.'"

questions.question: Though God had cast them far off among the nations, what did He promise to be to the exiles for a little while in the countries where they have gone?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:16 (ESV): "yet I have been a sanctuary to them for a while in the countries where they have gone."

questions.question: What will the returned exiles remove from the land of Israel?
options: All its detestable things and all its abominations
The walls and the high towers
questions.correctAnswer: All its detestable things and all its abominations
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:18 (ESV): "And when they come there, they will remove from it all its detestable things and all its abominations."

questions.question: "And I will give them one... , and a new... I will put within them. I will remove the... of stone from their flesh and give them a... of flesh,"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:19 (ESV): "And I will give them one heart, and a new spirit I will put within them. I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,"

questions.question: Where did the glory of the Lord finally go and stand after going up from the midst of the city?
options: On the mountain that is on the east side of the city
Over the temple mount in the clouds
questions.correctAnswer: On the mountain that is on the east side of the city
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 11:23 (ESV): "And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood on the mountain that is on the east side of the city." (The Mount of Olives).

key_verse_text: "And I will give them one heart, and a new spirit I will put within them. I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh, that they may walk in my statutes and keep my rules and obey them. And they shall be my people, and I will be their God."
